data.narrative:
Picogrid is a Series A-stage company in the Defense & Security sector that has raised $45M+ to date. Valuation analysis draws from a peer universe of 10 comparable companies—2 public (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private entities including Stark Defence, Singularity, NODA AI, Anduril Industries, and Helsing.

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis, using the $45M total raised as a proxy baseline and applying a 2.0x multiplier typical of Series A-to-next-stage advancement, implies a valuation of $90M. Peer-median analysis across three same-sector, same-stage comparables (Stark Defence at $4.0B, Singularity at $400M, and NODA AI at $125M) yields a median valuation of $400M, with a range spanning $125M to $4.0B. The wide peer dispersion reflects substantial variation in Defense & Security valuations at this stage.

Triangulating both methods produces a valuation range of $76M (low) to $460M (high), with a median of $245M. Stage-progression anchors the lower bound, while peer medians support the upper range. Key uncertainties include the outsized impact of Stark Defence's $4.0B valuation on the peer median—a potential outlier—and the heterogeneity of business models within the Defense & Security vertical. Further clarity on Picogrid's revenue, customer concentration, and technical differentiation would refine the estimate.
